# A readonly proof of a method of a generic type travels in the facts of the
# defining package: an importing package satisfies a const method obligation
# and calls through a const view with the proven methods, and a mutating
# method of a generic type stays rejected with the same rule ID.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/lib.a ./lib
go tool pack p $WORK/lib.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn \(\*Box\)\.Count .*Readonly'
stdout '^fn Box\.Size .*Readonly'
stdout '^fn \(\*Bumper\)\.Count '
stdout '^fn Bumper\.Size '
! stdout '^fn \(\*Bumper\)\.Count .*Readonly'
! stdout '^fn Bumper\.Size .*Readonly'

logos build -o $WORK/good.a ./good
! stderr .

! logos build -o $WORK/bad.a ./bad
stderr 'bad.lgo:.*const_view_mutation'
! stderr 'good\.lgo'
! exists $WORK/bad.a

! logos build -o $WORK/badview.a ./badview
stderr 'badview.lgo:.*const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/badview.a

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/genrecv

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Box[T any] struct {
	N  int
	Xs []T
}

func (b *Box[T]) Count() int {
	return b.N
}

func (b Box[T]) Size() int {
	return len(b.Xs)
}

type Bumper[T any] struct {
	N  int
	Xs []T
}

func (b *Bumper[T]) Count() int {
	b.N++
	return b.N
}

func (b Bumper[T]) Size() int {
	var zero T
	b.Xs[0] = zero
	return len(b.Xs)
}

-- w/good/good.lgo --
package good

import "example.com/genrecv/lib"

type Counter interface {
	const Count() int
}

type Sized interface {
	const Size() int
}

var _ Counter = &lib.Box[string]{}

var _ Sized = lib.Box[[]int]{}

func Size(b const lib.Box[string]) int {
	return b.Size()
}

-- w/bad/bad.lgo --
package bad

import "example.com/genrecv/lib"

type Counter interface {
	const Count() int
}

var _ Counter = &lib.Bumper[int]{}

-- w/badview/badview.lgo --
package badview

import "example.com/genrecv/lib"

func Size(b const lib.Bumper[string]) int {
	return b.Size()
}
